# SASSA Help Hub

> Your independent guide to SASSA grants, payment dates, and applications in South Africa.

- Home: https://www.sassahelphub.co.za/
- SRD R370 Grant Guide: https://www.sassahelphub.co.za/grants/srd-r370-grant
- Old Age Pension Guide: https://www.sassahelphub.co.za/grants/old-age-pension
- Child Support Grant Guide: https://www.sassahelphub.co.za/grants/child-support-grant
- Disability Grant Guide: https://www.sassahelphub.co.za/grants/disability-grant
- Foster Child Grant Guide: https://www.sassahelphub.co.za/grants/foster-child-grant
- Payment Calendar: https://www.sassahelphub.co.za/payment-calendar
- SASSA Status Check: https://www.sassahelphub.co.za/status-check

## Key Information

- SASSA Helpline: 0800 60 10 11
- SRD Portal: https://srd.sassa.gov.za
- Appeals Portal: https://srd-appeals.dsd.gov.za
- SASSA WhatsApp: 082 046 8553
- USSD Codes: *120*69277# (SRD status), *120*3210# (Postbank balance), *134*7737# (apply)
